about: Cracker Country is a living history village inside the Florida State Fairgrounds in Tampa. For Christmas in the Country, interpreters show how families in 19th century Florida prepared for the holiday by preserving food, sewing clothes and making decorations by hand.

The fairgrounds explain that rural families decorated with palmetto fronds, Florida holly, magnolia branches, pinecones and citrus fruit. Popcorn garlands and paper ornaments were handmade, and many presents were handmade too.
The site also describes serenading, a country custom where groups traveled from farm to farm ringing cowbells and banging tin pans, and the households welcomed them in with small gifts and treats.
Tickets are $16 for adults 12 and up, $14 for seniors, $12 for ages 6 to 11 and free for ages 0 to 5. Parking is $10 online or $12 onsite, and the Cracker Country entrance is off MLK Blvd at Gate 2.
faq: Adults 12 and up are $16, seniors $14 and ages 6 to 11 are $12. Ages 0 to 5 are free.

site: Christmas tree light show with snowfall
about: Symphony in Lights is the annual Christmas tree light show with snowfall at The Shops at Wiregrass, an open air center in Wesley Chapel. AdventHealth Wesley Chapel presents it, and the shows run at 6, 7, 8 and 9 PM every night through December 31, 2026.

Local groups add community holiday performances at 6:15, 7:15 and 8:15 PM on the center's schedule from November 1 to December 31. The center also lists a Wrap It Up for Charity gift wrapping fundraiser run by local groups on select dates and times.

Severe weather can cause technical difficulties and change the show schedule, the center warns. Its events page also lists Barnes and Noble Saturday Storytime and Build-A-Bear sensory friendly time on Tuesdays at 10 AM.

The center describes itself as Tampa Bay's premier outdoor lifestyle destination, easily walkable, with national retailers, local boutiques and more than 100 events a year. Pottery Barn lists a Home for the Holidays event from November 13 to January 2.
Because the shows repeat hourly, families can arrive any evening without a fixed start time, and the last show is at 9 PM.

about: Pajama Party Fridays is a themed take on the Santa photo visit at The Shops at Wiregrass. The center's listing says to throw on favorite cozy pajamas, grab the family and capture a magical holiday memory in sleepwear.
Four Fridays remain: November 27, December 4 and December 11 from 11 AM to 7 PM, and December 18 from 10 AM to 8 PM. The opening night on November 20 ran 1 to 7 PM.

For other ways to see Santa, the center's events page lists Photos with Santa from November 14 to December 24, Santa Pet Photos from November 16 to December 14, Cowboy Claus from November 17 to December 22 and Baby's First Photo from November 18 to December 23.

about: Sensory Santa is a one hour Santa visit at The Shops at Wiregrass on Sunday, December 6, 2026. The center files it under Santa Cares and designs it for children with sensory sensitivities.
The listing promises a calm, welcoming moment. It says the room is adjusted to reduce bright lights, loud sounds and long wait times, so each child can feel comfortable.
Spots fill up fast, so the center asks for registration. The center's events page also lists Build-A-Bear Workshop sensory friendly time on Tuesdays at 10 AM for another quiet outing.
Pajama Party Fridays and Photos with Santa are separate programs on other dates.

The Shops at Wiregrass is an outdoor center in Wesley Chapel that describes itself as easily walkable, with more than 100 events a year. The Santa Cares session is one of its Santa programs this season.
The center's Photos with Santa program runs from November 14 to December 24 for families who want a different date.
